Bid1.title: Student and Staff Computing Devices
Bid1.bid_submission_type: Online via iSupplier portal or manual submission of one (1) original hard copy in a sealed envelope
Bid1.term_of_bid: 3-year initial agreement with two (2) successive 1-year extensions, not to exceed a total of 5 years
Bid1.pre_bid_meeting: June 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM CST via TEAMS video conference (Meeting ID: 270 031 467 036, Passcode: N9ndKY)
Bid1.installation: Deployment services required include white glove services (asset decaling, asset reporting, laser etching on laptops), software setup (Autopilot enrollment for Windows, Google Management enrollment for Chromebooks), and delivery to varied district locations.
additional_documentation_required: Factory-authorized repair and maintenance certifications (for resellers)
Detailed plan for tracking shipped products and deployment services
Bid1.bid_summary: Dallas Independent School District is soliciting proposals for student and staff computing devices, including Chromebooks, Windows laptops, Apple tablets, desktop computers, and display monitors, as well as associated deployment, white glove services, and warranties.
Bid1.product_specification: Minimum hardware specifications include: Tier 1 Small Student Chromebook (11.6" Touch, Celeron N100, 8GB DDR5, 64GB eMMC); Tier 2 Large Student Chromebook (14" Non-Touch, Celeron N100, 8GB DDR5, 128GB eMMC); Tier 3 Student Windows Laptop (13", Intel i5 13th Gen, 16GB DDR5, 256GB SSD, Win 11 Pro); Student Tablet (10.2" Retina, A13, 64GB, iOS 17); Staff Basic/Professional Desktops (23.8" Touch, Intel i5/i7 14th Gen, 16/32GB RAM, 512GB/1TB SSD, Win 11 Pro/Mac OS); Staff Laptops (13", Intel i5/i7 14th Gen, 16/32GB RAM, 512GB/1TB SSD, Win 11 Pro/Mac OS); Touch and Non-Touch Display Monitors (24", 1920x1080, USB 3.1 Hub).

Bid2.bid_submission_type: Online portal via eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA)
additional_documentation_required: Letter of Authorization (LOA) from Manufacturer or Distributor
Bid2.contract_or_cooperative_to_use: Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract (060B5400007)
Bid2.model_no: SI# CC7802 (Dell Latitude 5550), WD22TB4 (Dell Thunderbolt 4 Dock)
Bid2.product: Dell Latitude 5550 Laptops and Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks
Bid2.contact_info: Tamaira Hawkins, Procurement Officer; Phone: 410-260-7533; Email: thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us; Address: MD State Treasurer's Office, 80 Calvert Street, Room 109, Annapolis, MD 21401
Bid2.bid_summary: The Maryland State Treasurer's Office is seeking proposals for a laptop refresh to acquire 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops (Microsoft Copilot ready), 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4), and a 3-year Dell Limited Hardware Extended Warranty for all machines.
Bid2.product_specification: Dell Latitude 5550 laptops (Microsoft Copilot ready) equipped with Intel Core Ultra 5 125U processor (12 MB cache, 12 cores, up to 4.3 GHz Turbo), Windows 11 Pro, 16 GB DDR5 RAM (2 x 8 GB), 256 GB PCIe NVMe SSD, 15.6" FHD 1920x1080 display, ENERGY STAR qualified, and 3-year Dell Limited Hardware Extended Warranty; along with Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4).
